title: Final circle review
missingBody: The organizer must create the final financial snapshot before members can review and accept it.
missingBodyMember: Your organizer must create the final financial snapshot before you can review and accept the circle terms.
draftNotice: Review the final circle terms carefully before accepting.
yourHandsTitle: Your hands covered by this acceptance
yourHandsHint: Accepting once covers every hand listed below for your account on this exact snapshot.
participantBody: Review the contribution schedule, hands, fees, late/default and withdrawal rules, manual-payment limits, provider reversals and disputes, no-guarantee language, and your duty to verify this final configuration.
participantCheck: I reviewed the Circle Participation Agreement and this financial arrangement.
snapshotBody: Accept the exact hands, positions, dates, amount, frequency, rounds, organizer participation, and fee information in this snapshot.
snapshotCheck: I reviewed this exact final payout order and financial snapshot.
organizerBody: Organizer duties include accurate payout order and records, member approvals, manual-payment review, privacy, prohibited conduct, dispute cooperation, no unauthorized changes, and discrepancy reporting.
organizerCheck: I reviewed and accept the Organizer Agreement responsibilities.
acceptedBoth: You accepted the participant agreement and final payout order for this snapshot.
ready: All agreement acceptances are current. Complete the organizer start confirmations below.
readyMember: Your acceptances are current for this snapshot. The organizer can start once every required acceptance is complete.
blockerSnapshotMissing: Final snapshot required — create the final review snapshot
blockerOrganizerSnapshot: Organizer must accept the final circle snapshot
blockerStaleAcceptances: Some acceptances are for an older snapshot — members must re-accept
startBlockedStructural: This circle is not structurally ready to start. Check hands, payout order, and pending requests.
startPayoutCheck: I reviewed the payout order for this circle.
startUnclaimedCheck: I will manage contributions for every unclaimed participating hand.
startConfirmBody: Starting locks the participating hands and payout order. Review the details carefully before continuing.
startBodyInformational: Review the circle details before starting. Starting locks the payout order and participating hands.
structureLockWarning: Starting locks the payout order and participating hands.
memberInformationalOnly: Your organizer will start the circle when the structure is ready. No acceptance action is required from you.
missingBodyStructural: Start the circle to lock the structure. A final structure snapshot is created automatically at start when needed.
stale: The circle structure changed. Refresh and review again.
genericError: The request could not be completed. Please try again.
additionalDraft: Draft consent wording — pending licensed counsel approval.
additionalCheck: I understand and affirmatively accept these exact additional recurring and remaining dollar obligations.
additionalAction: Request additional hand and accept new obligation
requestSent: Additional-hand request and consent evidence were saved.
previewExpired: The preview expired or the circle changed. A new server-calculated preview is required.
